## ⚙️ Configuration & Directory Grouping (`textify.yaml`)
Directories can be tagged with an optional `group` property in `textify.yaml`. You can configure which groups export lightweight symbol signatures versus full source code, saving tokens while preserving implementation details where needed:
```yaml # textify.yaml output_file: codebase.txt format: tags
# Specify group extraction modes signatures_groups: - models - generated
full_code_groups: - core - api
# Or configure modes via the groups map: groups: helpers: signatures services: full
dirs: cmd/api: enabled: true group: api
internal/core: enabled: true group: core
internal/models: enabled: true group: models
internal/generated: enabled: true group: generated ```
When running `textify start`, directories in `signatures_groups` have function bodies stripped, while `full_code_groups` include complete implementations.
You can also filter or override groups dynamically from the CLI:
```bash # Bundle only directories and files belonging to a specific group textify start --group=core -c
# Bundle with custom signature and full-code groups textify start --signatures-groups=models,helpers --full-groups=api ```

## ⚙️ Configuration, File Filtering & Directory Grouping (`textify.yaml`)
Textify supports fine-grained control over which files and folders are bundled, filtered, or extracted via `textify.yaml`.
### Complete Configuration Schema
When you run `textify init`, Textify auto-discovers your directory tree, detects visible file extensions, and generates a fully documented `textify.yaml`:
```yaml # Textify Configuration # # output_file: Path where the merged codebase text will be saved. # format: Output format ("raw", "markdown", or "tags") # tree: Prepend ASCII directory tree (default true) # max_file_size: File size limit in bytes (default 500KB) # dirs: Directory-specific configurations. Keys are paths relative to root.
output_file: codebase.txt format: tags tree: true max_file_size: 512000
# Group extraction modes (Signatures vs Full Code) signatures_groups: - models - generated
full_code_groups: - core - api
groups: helpers: signatures services: full
dirs: .: enabled: true extensions: - go - md - yaml exclude_extensions: - log - tmp include: - .env.example exclude: - obsolete.go
cmd/api: enabled: true group: api
internal/core: enabled: true group: core compact: true ```
### Rule & Filtering Options per Directory (`dirs`)
Every directory rule supports the following properties: - **`enabled`** *(bool)*: If `false`, this directory and its subdirectories are completely skipped during scans. - **`compact`** *(bool)*: If `true`, strips extra whitespace and non-essential blank lines to conserve LLM tokens. - **`group`** *(string)*: Assigns the directory to a named group (e.g., `api`, `models`, `core`). - **`extensions`** *(list)*: Allow-list of file extensions (e.g., `[go, ts, md]`). If empty, all non-binary text files are considered. - **`exclude_extensions`** *(list)*: Block-list of file extensions to ignore (e.g., `[log, tmp, lock]`). - **`include`** *(list)*: Specific files or glob patterns to **Force Include**, overriding gitignore rules and extension filters. - **`exclude`** *(list)*: Specific files or glob patterns to **Force Exclude** (takes highest precedence).
### Rule Precedence Order When Textify scans files, rules are evaluated in this exact priority: 1. **System exclusions** (`.git`, `textify.yaml`, output file). 2. **Force exclusions** (`exclude` rules). 3. **Force inclusions** (`include` rules — overrides gitignore and extension filters). 4. **Gitignore rules** (root and subfolder `.gitignore` files). 5. **Extension block-lists** (`exclude_extensions`). 6. **Extension allow-lists** (`extensions`).
### Group Extraction Modes When running `textify start`, directories tagged with `signatures_groups` or group mode `signatures` have function bodies stripped, while `full_code_groups` include complete implementations.
You can also filter or override groups dynamically from the CLI: ```bash # Bundle only directories and files belonging to a specific group textify start --group=core -c
# Bundle with custom signature and full-code groups textify start --signatures-groups=models,helpers --full-groups=api ```
